subject: Renewal scope variance & procurement queue sync
messages:
From: Lisa Grant <lisa@cloudops-acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: evidence cadence + staggered PO request

Hi Mina,

Hope you had a great weekend. We're finalizing the renewal for Acme's platform commitment (term renewal + 20% capacity uplift) and procurement has asked for two changes before we issue the PO:

1) We need a clear evidence/upload cadence for SOC2 docs and the vendor onboarding refresh (security artifacts).
2) Procurement prefers splitting the renewal into two POs across FY quarters (staggered PO / commit ramp) rather than one large PO — finance says it helps cashflow.

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to accept two POs tied to the same contract amendment and a recommended schedule for the evidence handoff? If possible, include the SOW amendment that maps the 20% capacity uplift to the commit ladder.

Attaching a simple template of Acme's procurement intake for your reference.

Thanks,
Lisa
Cloud Ops
Acme Corp
[attachment: acme_procure_template.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa@cloudops-acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence cadence + staggered PO request

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and the template.

Short answer: we can support two POs against a single amended SOW and map them to a staggered commit ladder. Below is a proposed operational plan that we've used with other customers.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Agreement/SOW: we issue SOW Amendment v2 that shows total annual quantity + the commit ladder (Q4: 40%, Q1: 60%). The SOW references both PO numbers.
- PO routing: Acme submits PO#1 to start on 2027-10-01 (covers initial 40% commit). PO#2 issue date target 2028-01-05 (remaining 60%). Both POs reference the SOW amendment.
- Evidence cadence: security and onboarding artifacts submitted via our secure evidence intake (shared Drive link) in three deliverables:
  1) Base bundle (SOC2 report, encryption overview, network diagram) — available immediately upon SOW acceptance.
  2) Operational playbook (audit logs, retention policies) — delivered within 7 business days after PO#1 is processed.
  3) Access/credential refresh (service account onboarding steps, KMS pointers) — delivered before PO#2 activation.

I'll attach the draft SOW amendment and a suggested commit schedule spreadsheet. Connor, can you confirm the PO processing notes and whether our billing team needs a formal PO split memo? Vanessa, can you confirm the evidence upload drive and who will own the audit playbook?

Best,
Mina
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW-Amendment-v2.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: acme_commit_schedule.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Grant <lisa@cloudops-acme.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: evidence cadence + staggered PO request

Thanks Mina / Lisa — I can confirm operationally this is fine. A couple of clarifications from billing/ops: 

- Billing needs both PO numbers referenced on the invoice(s) and the SOW amendment number. We will invoice against PO#1 as soon as service starts; invoice terms unchanged.
- For internal gating, our finance team needs a short PO-splitting memo (1 paragraph) that procurement can sign — this is just to keep audit trails clean. Mina — I can draft that and loop in finance for signatures.
- On capacity ramp: please confirm whether the 20% is a guaranteed minimum or flexible burst. If guaranteed, we'll flag the capacity in our Dedicated pool for Q4.

Lisa — Vanessa will own the evidence intake. Vanessa, can you confirm the Drive link and expected file names? Also, do we want to run the onboarding refresh call with Acme's security team this month?

Connor
Senior Renewal Ops, Redwood Inference
